annotations.title: Maximum affordable CAC and cost per lead

description: Works back from customer lifetime value to the most a business can pay to acquire a customer (and, optionally, a lead) while keeping a target LTV to CAC ratio, 3:1 by default.

currency.description: ISO currency code for display, for example INR, USD or AED. Defaults to INR.

lead_to_customer_pct.description: Optional. Share of leads that become customers, to work out the maximum cost per lead.

monthly_churn_pct.description: Share of customers lost per month as a percentage.

monthly_revenue_per_customer.description: Average revenue per customer per month (ARPU), in currency units.

target_ltv_to_cac.description: Target LTV to CAC ratio, for example 3 for 3:1.

name: max_affordable_cac
title: Maximum affordable CAC and cost per lead
